title: snarkjs+
tagline: snarkjs frameworks improved with an input.json file generation
description:
snarkjs is a wonderful framework to generate ZK proofs, however when you are building new circuits you actually need to generate an input.json file at the right format manually.
This snarkjs forked brings a new feature to the cli by adding the "gi" command which generates automatically an input.json file according to circuit.circom.
how_its_made:
As this project implements new commands in snarkjs, code is only javascript.
The core of the code is at src/input.js and the command has been added in cli.
I also added the -rust|-r option to cast the input to a more rusty format, which can be really useful while rust witness generator such as https://github.com/philsippl/circom-witness-rs
